description: Creates an empty private list (e.g. Narozeniny, Nová kuchyň) in the signed-in person's account; add products with add_to_list. At most 50 lists per person.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

name.description: The list's name, e.g. Narozeniny (1 to 80 characters).

name: create_list
title: Create a named list
